name: LGND ENERGY
old_description: Your home is one of the biggest investments you will ever make. Utilizing solar energy will help improve the value of a home while giving you benefits while living in the home. Solar panels from LGND Energy are of the highest quality on the market in New Mexico. We have been working to provide roofing and solar solutions for homeowners for many years. Using solar energy gives you the freedom to control your power production, lower your energy bill, and help improve the environment.
about:
LGND Energy operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, where brothers Elmer and Octavio Reyna founded the company in 2019. After years leading sales teams at larger solar firms, the Reyna brothers launched their own dealership to bring a family-oriented approach to both their representatives and customers across the Southwest.

The company designs and installs residential and commercial photovoltaic systems, integrates battery storage using Tesla Powerwall 3 and Enphase units, and provides roofing consultations that assess structural readiness for solar arrays. Crews also fit critter guards, clean panels, and handle permitting and HOA coordination for projects throughout Bernalillo County and the wider Albuquerque metro area.

Homeowners, small and large businesses, and multi-family property owners make up the client base. Recent work includes pigeon-barrier installations on residential arrays, commercial rooftop systems aimed at lowering operating costs, and backup-battery retrofits that keep power flowing during grid outages.

The founders frame the business around passing installation savings directly to homeowners and rewarding sales staff without high-pressure tactics. Extensive rep training and a hands-on, family-run culture are cited as the reasons customers return for maintenance and refer neighbors.
